invariants: One page per child per calendar month in family time; the Overview offers the last finished month, from the month after the first confirmed delivery
Made on request, never stored; answers are private, no-store
No transcripts, photos, guesses, percent right, wrong-answer counts or comparison with other children
Names the child, never she or her
Skills mastered that month is left out until #578 and #575
